privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. We collect and use some personal data in accordance with current legislation, mainly to ensure the best possible experience on the platform.
privacyPolicy.dataUsage: By creating an account, you agree to the collection and use of the information provided, such as name, email, and musical preferences, for authentication, personalization, and security purposes.
privacyPolicy.dataSharing: Your data will not be shared with third parties without your consent, except when required by law.
privacyPolicy.support: For more information or questions, please contact our support.

termsOfUse.title: Terms of Use
termsOfUse.agreement: By using this platform, you agree to respect the established rules and policies, including the responsible use of features and providing truthful information during registration.
termsOfUse.prohibited: It is not permitted to use the platform for illegal, offensive purposes or that violate third-party rights.
termsOfUse.breach: Failure to comply with the terms may result in account suspension or deletion.
termsOfUse.updates: These terms may be updated periodically. We recommend that you review them regularly.
